result: Hostile, typically an immediate attack by a hostile encounter
Danger, a dangerous or potentially hazardous encounter; can mean an active physical threat (storm, flood, trap, etc.)
Obstacle, a barrier to progress, which could be locked gates, guards, security systems, etc.
Neutral feature/observation, a point of interest, not immediately dangerous, such as a landscape feature
Information, a potential lead, or opportunity (clue, track, hint, informant)
Useful, a discovery, meeting, or useful resource
